newsitem.title: UK: Sugar market still awaits outcome of Libyan tender.
newsitem.headline: Sugar market still awaits outcome of Libyan tender.

text.p: European sugar traders continued to wait for definite news about Libya's recent buying tender on Monday although they cited market talk that up to four cargoes could have already been sold.
"I don't know whether they're going to postpone or they're going to come back and book with somebody," said one trader.
"They kept postponing everything...but they usually buy."
Another European trader said Libya might have bought around four cargoes, one for November shipment and three for December, with prices quoted in Swiss francs.
But a third source played down talk of any sale to Libya as "market rumours", saying there was no confirmation as yet.
"We know Libya is in the market. We are working on it," he said.
Libya postponed the deadline for bids in its tender to buy 14,000 tonnes of 45 ICUMSA white sugar, setting a new deadline for Monday after an original date of October 17.
